## Experience

- **Google** (London, UK) — Senior Software Engineer, SRE, Agentic AI (2026–Present): Reliability, blackbox testing frameworks (load tests, synthetic probers), capacity planning, and production incident response for Gemini Enterprise and Google's Agentic Platform Runtime.
- **Google** (London, UK) — Senior Software Engineer, SRE, Tech Lead, Ads (2022–2026): Custom OLAP Critical User Journey (CUJ) observability across AdSense, AdMob, and Google Ads Manager; LLM-powered multi-agent onboarding automation; AI-driven alerting and Performance Max (PMax) reliability.
- **DoorDash** (Japan) — Senior Software Engineer (2021–2022): Launched DashPass annual subscription and AfterPay partnership in Australia; store search and A/B testing frameworks in Japan.
- **ExaWizards** (Japan) — Software Engineer, Tech Lead (2019–2021): Led CompanySearch AI-based company search engine from PoC to launch; hybrid high-dimensional vector similarity search scheduler across PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch.
- **Indeed** (Japan) — Software Engineer (2017–2019): Private cloud infrastructure engineering and optimization.
- **Google** (Beijing & Mountain View HQ) — Software Engineer (2013–2017): Backend and data pipelines for Street View, Android Studio, Google Play Music / YouTube Music, and Go (Golang).

## Research & Academic Projects

- **From Prototyping to Production: An AI-Powered Approach to Scaling Jupyter Notebooks via Kubeflow Pipelines (`nb2kf`)** — University of Edinburgh (2025–2026), accepted as a poster at **IEEE eScience 2026**: Autonomous multi-agent framework in Go and Python (Google ADK, Gemini) compiling unannotated Jupyter Notebooks into hardware-aware Kubeflow Pipelines (KFP v2) DAGs on Kubernetes, achieving 84% autonomous cluster execution success across 100 ML notebooks and 90% zero-code-change GPU portability on NVIDIA L40/A100 (EIDF).
- **Top-K Vector Similarity Search with Filters** — University of York (2022): Benchmarked linear scan, Faiss, PostgreSQL, and Elasticsearch; designed an adaptive hybrid query scheduler validated via Multi-factor ANOVA.
